positions.title: Full-time parenting

positions.title: Recreation Assistant
positions.description: Greeted and assisted members, maintained exercise equipment, completed exercise assessments, ensured the facility was clean and ready for use per strict cleaning regulations.

positions.title: Family Services Coordinator
positions.description: Ensured each patient encounter was positive, professional, and efficient while creating new registrations and checking in patients in an outpatient setting of the hospital.

positions.title: Community Resource Navigator
positions.description: As a Community Resource Navigator, my responsibilities are to provide information and assistance to individuals seeking health coverage, health care and other local resources that aid them in maintaining a healthy life style; Help in educating eligible individuals on how to navigate health insurance options, public programs, and Sea Mar services and assist with the application processes; Aid newly assigned and high-risk patients in scheduling their initial appointment for medical, dental and care management services; Provide case management and participate in intervention strategies to remove barriers that may result in appointment no shows.

positions.title: Health Resource Specialist
positions.description: My responsibilities included serving a diverse patient population and the greater community; providing linkage to health care resources and information; understanding the current healthcare policies; promoting outreach to under served community members and established patients; coordinating and conducting dental screenings at local elementary schools; creating,planning, and executing health-care focused events in clinics and community centers; recruiting and supervising volunteers; acting as main point of contact between the community and the clinic.

positions.title: Library Student Assistant
positions.description: My responsibilities included interacting with patrons and assisting them with checking out materials; following inventory and quality control procedures; shelving, maintaining, shifting, picking up, and sorting books in the book stacks; becoming proficient in library software to check in and route requested materials; assisting with special projects and other circulation duties as assigned.

positions.title: Free Tax Campaing Intake and Benefits Specialist
positions.locationName: El Centro De La Raza, Beacon Hill, Seattle, WA
positions.description: My main responsibilities included answering questions, helping clients with paperwork, and connecting clients with additional resources like Basic Food, healthcare, and financial counseling.

positions.title: Youth Development Mentor
positions.description: My responsibilities included engaging middle and high school aged youth in hands-on project based learning; fostering civic engagement; encouraging post-secondary education; providing workforce preparation; developing leadership skills; helping participants address a broad spectrum of community and environmental issues.
